# BigLakeTable

`biglake.gcp.hfl.dev/v1beta1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_biglake_table`. A table in a BigLake Metastore database. Config Connector's own BigLakeTable (bigquerybiglake.cnrm.cloud.google.com) reads BigLake's 403 for a missing table as a denial and never creates one.
